candidates.title: The Misleading Echo
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a distress whistle seemed to come from the abandoned quarry before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the quarry, but nobody was there to answer; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the canyon wall was reflecting a whistle from the opposite ridge; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they followed the direct sound and helped the stranded traveler return, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Mixed Seed Trays
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the nursery's labeled seedlings grew into the wrong flowers before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they swapped the labels, but the next row was still mismatched; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the trays had been rotated when the greenhouse roof was repaired; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they matched each seedling to the planting records and restored the rows, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Stuck Ferry Rope
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the small ferry stopped halfway across the quiet channel before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they pulled harder, but the guide rope tightened around its wheel; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a drifting branch had jammed the pulley beneath the deck; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they cleared the branch from shore and tested the ferry before passengers boarded, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
